card.name: Digits before mcg dose units
card.fires_on: A digit (often 5 or 0) inside a dose number that is directly followed by mcg, such as mcg/day or mcg/hour. Also fires on the bracket just before mcg in a rate heading.

modes.label: Digit ending a number
modes.description: The last digit of a dose number, usually 5 or 0, right before mcg.

modes.label: Digit starting a number
modes.description: The first digit of a starting dose, before the rest of the number and mcg.

modes.label: Bracket before unit
modes.description: An opening parenthesis in a table heading just before mcg/kg/min.
